records.source: Measure current or saved 3D image sets into their image-folder databases.

records.context: key-value mappings with ``source_path``, optional ``mask_path`` and extra ``channel_paths``. The current image supplies a ``snapshot`` containing immutable image data channels, copied labels, axes, spacing and unit, so unsaved edits are measured without changing their saved mask.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_volume_rows#1
records.source: dictionaries with ``source_path``, optional ``mask_path`` and extra ``channel_paths``. The current image supplies a ``snapshot`` containing immutable channels, copied labels, axes, spacing and unit, so unsaved edits are measured without changing their saved mask.
records.translation: 包含 ``source_path``、可选的 ``mask_path`` 以及附加 ``channel_paths`` 的字典。当前图像提供一个 ``snapshot``，其中包含不可变通道、复制的标签、轴、间距和单位，因此可以测量未保存的编辑，而不改变已保存的掩膜。

records.source: canonical object role, such as ``cell`` or ``nucleus``.
records.translation: 规范对象角色，例如 ``cell`` 或 ``nucleus``。

records.context: optional worker-safe callback receiving translated text.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_volume_rows#3
records.source: optional worker-safe callback receiving translated text.
records.translation: 可选回调，可安全地由工作线程调用，并接收翻译后的文本。

records.context: database paths, image count and object count. All rows are measured before any write; each destination commits atomically.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_volume_rows#4
records.source: database paths, image count and object count. All rows are measured before any write; each destination commits atomically.
records.translation: 数据库路径、图像数量和对象数量。在任何写入之前先测量所有行；每个目标分别以原子方式提交。

records.context: Stored morphology, intensity, correlation and spatial feature names follow Measure. Pixel coordinates stay explicitly pixel coordinates; physical metadata are converted to micrometres. Repeating an image set replaces only this entry point's earlier rows. Other microscope fields of view and tables are retained.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_volume_rows#5
records.source: Stored morphology, intensity, correlation and spatial feature names follow Measure. Pixel coordinates stay explicitly pixel coordinates; physical metadata are converted to micrometres. Repeating an image set replaces only this entry point's earlier rows. Other fields and tables are retained.
records.translation: 存储的形态、强度、相关性和空间特征名称遵循 Measure 的命名。像素坐标仍明确表示为像素坐标；物理元数据转换为微米。重复测量某个图像集仅替换此入口点此前写入的行。其他图像视野和表均保留。
